source_files.role: The oracle. All eight START_SECTIONs are ported; every transcribed literal in tests/mascot_generic.rs comes from this file.
Not ported here. Read for the exact semantics of trim, simplify, substitute, split, hasPrefix, substr, prefix, suffix and remove, on which every reader branch depends.
Not ported here. Read for toDouble/toInt32 (leading whitespace, one optional '+', complete token, nan accepted) and for the appendNumeric formatting precisionWrapper uses.

Not ported here. The 15/6-significant-digit rule with one retained fractional digit that this crate's crate::param::value::format_float already reproduces, and which the MGF writer's precisionWrapper calls.
Not ported here. Read for extractScanNumber, which the writer needs to fill SCANS=; only the accession table is reproduced locally.
Not ported here. Declares the accession-to-pattern table extractScanNumber dispatches on.
Not ported here. Source of the ten accession patterns, the index+1 rule and the WIFF cycle*1000+experiment encoding reproduced in mascot_generic.rs.

Not ported here. Read for getAllSearchModifications: full IDs of records with a UniMod record ID, sorted case-insensitively with the shorter string first, which is the valid-string list of both modification parameters.

fixtures.role: Unmodified upstream MGF input, still carrying its historical MascotInfile name: one block, TITLE=Testtitle, PEPMASS=1998 with no decimal point, RTINSECONDS=25.379, a blank line, and nine peaks whose fifth and seventh lines carry a trailing comment in a third whitespace field (one uses two spaces, one a tab). The comments survive the reader only because the source parses a third field as the optional per-peak charge and discards it.

Unmodified upstream GNPS library spectrum: PEPMASS=981.54, CHARGE=1 with no sign, SPECTRUMID and COMPOUND_NAME, a SMILES string, SCANS=1, MSLEVEL=2 and 43 peaks. Its ADDUCT= and ION_MODE= lines match no source prefix and are silently dropped, which is what makes it the fixture that pins that behaviour.

source_anchors.operation: load declares one spectrum outside the read loop and reuses it for every block, which is what makes the carry-over below observable

getNextSpectrum_ resets only the peak list, the native ID, TITLE and SEQ; retention time, precursor m/z, precursor intensity, precursor charge, MS level and every other meta value survive into the next block
isdigit(line[0]) decides where the peak list starts; the argument is a possibly negative char, which is undefined behaviour for non-ASCII input
simplify merges runs of whitespace before splitting, explicitly because double spaces are allowed by the MGF standard; the following substitute of tab for space is then redundant
split(line, ' ', split, false) returns false only when the line holds no separator at all, so that is the sole condition reported as 'does not contain m/z and intensity values'

only split[0] and split[1] are converted; a third field -- nominally the optional per-peak charge the error text names -- is never touched, which is why '100 1 garbage' loads and why the upstream fixture can smuggle comments past the reader
the do/while condition trims each line before comparing it with END IONS, so the terminator tolerates surrounding whitespace
end of file after the peak list started is a ParseError; end of file before it leaves the inner and outer loops and returns false, dropping the block silently

PEPMASS accepts exactly one or two whitespace-separated entries; three or more is a ParseError naming the count. The value is tab-substituted but NOT simplified, unlike a peak line, so 'PEPMASS=500  10' splits into three fields with an empty middle one and takes that error
CHARGE removes every '+' and then requires a complete int32, so '2+' and '+2' parse while '2-' and a charge list raise an uncaught ConversionError

a TITLE containing 'min' anywhere is read as a Bruker export: the retention time comes from the first whitespace token of every comma chunk containing 'min', in minutes, and no TITLE meta value is stored at all. setRT is called inside the loop and the single enclosing catch does not undo it, so a retention time an earlier chunk committed survives a later chunk's failure
the catch branch stores only the text between the first and second '=', truncating a title that contains a second '='
the native ID is appended to the title unless the already stored title contains it, so a second TITLE= line in one block replaces the first without the suffix
NAME and COMPOUND_NAME both map to Constants::UserParam::MSM_METABOLITE_NAME
the ion-mode branch tests the prefix IONMODE, so the GNPS spelling ION_MODE matches nothing and is dropped
MSLEVEL is read with std::stoi: a numeric prefix wins, invalid_argument falls back to MS2 and records MSLEVEL=2 as a meta value, out_of_range falls back silently
SEQ is always stored as a StringList, even for a single line, and accumulates across repeated lines in one query
the header loop has no END IONS branch, so a block with no peak line does not end there: the loop keeps reading and the block merges into the following one
special_modifications defaults to the Mascot 2.4 specificity groups; the comment notes Phospho (STY) is deliberately absent because Phospho (ST) plus Phospho (Y) covers it
updateMembers_ builds mod_group_map_ from prefix(mod, ' ') and the residues between the last '(' and the first ')' after it, one entry per residue
store to a path requires the MGF extension and a writable destination before the stream is opened
internal:content selects header, peak list or both
writeModifications_ maps each entry through mod_group_map_ and collects into a std::set, so output is sorted by identifier and a group named twice appears once
FORMAT must stay within the first five lines, because it is how OpenMS recognises its own MGF files when the suffix is not MGF
a spectrum with 10,000 peaks or more raises IllegalArgument, with a message attributing it to profile data
a precursor m/z of exactly zero prints to cout and writes nothing at all for that spectrum
a stored TITLE meta value is written verbatim, because it was either parsed from an MGF or set to be written to one

SCANS is the text after the native ID's last '=' for the UNKNOWN accession sentinel and SpectrumLookup::extractScanNumber otherwise, whose -1 failure sentinel is streamed verbatim; its InvalidValue for a WIFF experiment of 1000 or more is not caught and aborts the store
the charge sign is written after the signed magnitude, so a charge of -3 becomes CHARGE=-3-, which the reader at MascotGenericFile.h:239 cannot read back

the compact writer skips zero-intensity peaks and uses five fixed decimals for m/z and three for intensity; the default writer uses precisionWrapper for both. 'fixed' is streamed here and in the generated-title branch only, so a compact spectrum that already carries a TITLE has its PEPMASS and RTINSECONDS written in the stream's default float format -- five and three SIGNIFICANT digits -- and the flag then stays set for the rest of the file
the file name recorded in generated titles is the path stem with every non-alphanumeric character removed
only MS level 2 is written; level 0 warns and every other level is dropped in silence

StringUtils::substr clamps its start position to the string length, so a header line shorter than its own key yields an empty value instead of failing: a bare NAME stores an empty metabolite name and a bare MSLEVEL takes the std::stoi invalid_argument fallback

toDouble skips leading space, tab, CR and LF, consumes one '+' and hands the rest to std::from_chars, which refuses a second '+' and reports an overflowing decimal literal as result_out_of_range -- a conversion error, not an infinity. Only the inf/nan words convert to a non-finite value
toInt32 has the same one-'+' rule through the integer std::from_chars overload, so '++1' is a conversion error

the token iterator collects every match and converts only matches.back() with toInt32, so the last match wins even when its digits overflow 32 bits and an earlier convertible match is not a fallback; the failure is logged and answered with -1

the WIFF branch collects two subgroups and examines only the final cycle/experiment pair, so an earlier pair with an experiment of 1000 or more is never seen; that ceiling raises Exception::InvalidValue, which the surrounding catch (ConversionError only) does not handle
the WIFF expression separates the pair with a whitespace-run escape, and Boost's whitespace class for char covers space, tab, CR, LF, vertical tab and form feed

evidence: Tier 3 source review. Every expectation is either a transcribed literal from MascotGenericFile_test.cpp or read off MascotGenericFile.cpp/.h; the transcribed literals are therefore tier-3 evidence and are labelled as such. No C++ was built or executed and no C++ output was retained, so this is not a tier 1 differential: the upstream suite retains no MGF output at all -- its two store sections compare substrings of an in-memory stringstream, and both committed fixtures are inputs. Transcribed and reproduced: one spectrum of nine peaks from MascotInfile_test.mascot_in; the written block TITLE=Testtitle_index=0 / PEPMASS=1998.0 / RTINSECONDS=25.379000000000001 / SCANS=0 with peak lines 1.0 1.0 through 9.0 81.0; the generated title 1998.0_25.379000000000001_index=0_test; MODS=Carbamidomethyl (C), MODS=Phospho (ST), IT_MODS=Deamidated (NQ), IT_MODS=Oxidation (M); the compact block TITLE=901.23457_234.568_index=250_test / PEPMASS=901.23457 / RTINSECONDS=234.568 / SCANS=250 / 890.12346 2345.679; Caffeine under Metabolite_Name with two peaks, precursor 500.0 and charge 1; and the GNPS spectrum's CCMSLIB00000001547, 3-Des-Microcystein_LR, precursor 981.54, charge 1, 43 peaks and base peak 599.352783 at intensity 764523.0, plus the four SEQ cases. The resource ceilings, the non-ASCII inputs, the multi-byte-offset refusal, the carry-over comparison, the block-merge and truncation asymmetry, the CHARGE rejection set, the range filters, the consumer interface, the native-ID accession table and the parameter-header line order are independently derived (tier 4). A second-model adversarial review of this port raised nine findings, eight of which changed behaviour and each of which now has a named regression test: the PEPMASS whitespace rule, the title retention-time commit order, the compact precision with a stored TITLE, the substr clamp, the from_chars conversion strictness, the scan number's 32-bit width and last-match-wins rule, the WIFF final-pair rule with its uncaught InvalidValue, and the quadratic SEQ accumulation (433.9 s to 0.04 s in release mode on the Linux gate node for the 100,000-line ceiling). The ninth was the documentation correction that the third field of a peak line is ignored rather than parsed and discarded. The libc++-only acceptance of '0x10' by strtod is deliberately not reproduced, because the std::from_chars path every other platform takes rejects it.
gaps: ProgressLogger is a base class of the source file adapter and is not threaded through this port, so a large file reports no progress.

SpectrumLookup::extractScanNumber is reproduced only as the accession table the MGF writer reaches, with hand-coded scanning instead of Boost regular expressions. When METADATA/SpectrumLookup.h is ported, the local subset in mascot_generic.rs should be deleted in favour of it.

ModificationsDB has no all_search_modifications accessor in this crate, so the equivalent filter (a UniMod record ID, case-insensitive sort, shorter string first) lives in mascot_generic.rs. It belongs on the database once that module is revisited.
The three range filters and the MSDataConsumer interface are native additions; MascotGenericFile consumes no PeakFileOptions and has no consumer API upstream.
